info.title: ElBruno.AspireMonitor
info.description: Windows system tray monitor for Aspire distributed applications. Install as a global tool and launch with `aspiremon`. See your Aspire resources at a glance, pin the ones you care about in a compact mini window with full URLs, and start/stop your AppHost from the tray.
